evals.prompt: 用这个 product-delivery-manifest.yaml 发布 Package，但 Human approval 里的 payload fingerprint 已经过期。不要真实发布，用 fake/spy 验证调用边界。
evals.expected_output: Rejects the stale approval before the first DingTalk call and leaves the Manifest unchanged.

assertions.text: Canonical validation fails before dws auth or any remote write.
The fake/spy dws call log remains empty.
The failed preflight does not mutate the Manifest.

evals.prompt: 发布已批准的 Package。目录里还有一个更新但未列入 Manifest 的 HTML；第一次上传截图中途失败，随后重试。只使用 fake/spy。
evals.expected_output: Publishes only allowlisted artifacts, records the partial failure, and resumes on the same nodeId without recreating or repeating completed artifacts.

assertions.text: The unlisted sibling HTML is never sent to dws.
The retry reuses the captured nodeId and creates exactly one remote document.
Completed artifacts are skipped while the failed artifact is retried.

evals.prompt: Package 的 dws read-back 已成功。先报告当前状态，再消费由独立 browser actor 生成的结构化可见性证据。不要真实发布。
evals.expected_output: Keeps read-back-only delivery at published_unverified and records verified only after valid independent browser evidence.

assertions.text: Read-back alone does not produce verified.
Browser evidence must identify an independent verifier and pass all required checks.
Final verified status requires both read-back and browser visibility evidence.

evals.prompt: 尝试在 Package mode 里用 --folder 覆盖 Manifest 目标，并把 content path 改成 ../outside.md。用 fake/spy 证明不会产生副作用。
evals.expected_output: Rejects CLI target overrides and path traversal before remote calls without changing review or approval records.

assertions.text: Both override and traversal cases make zero dws calls.
Absolute, traversal, missing, hash-mismatched, and escaping paths fail closed.
Publisher failure cannot rewrite review or approval partitions.
